compose_version.description: Compose file version (e.g., "3.8"). Must be one of the officially supported versions per Docker Compose release.

project_name.description: Project name; overrides auto-detection. Must contain only lowercase letters, digits, dashes, and underscores, starting with a letter or digit.

services.description: List of service definitions. Each entry is a mapping with service name as key and service configuration as value. Each service supports standard Compose service fields like build, image, ports, volumes, etc.

networks.description: Optional network definitions. Each entry is a mapping with network name as key and network config as value. See official Compose reference for supported keys (e.g., driver, internal, ipam).

volumes.description: Optional named volume definitions. Each entry is a mapping with volume name as key and volume config as value (e.g., external, driver).
